In the Moon Mission Simulator, users make decisions about life-support resources, solar power, water recycling, food production, and radiation shielding. details:
ORVIX is an interactive space-learning website designed for children and college students. It combines education, games and mission simulations to make learning about space exciting and enjoyable.

The website includes Astronaut Academy, Explore Space, Training Games, Space Quiz and a Moon Mission Simulator. In the simulator, students act as mission commanders and manage oxygen, water, food and power while performing activities such as water recycling, food production, solar charging and radiation shielding.

ORVIX addresses the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge by helping students understand simplified astronaut training and the challenges of managing a lunar outpost.

Our project encourages curiosity, critical thinking, problem-solving and interest in space science. We used HTML, CSS and JavaScript, developed the website using Visual Studio Code, and published it through GitHub Pages. We also integrated NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day resource to introduce real space discoveries.

Our creative approach is to turn space education into an interactive adventure rather than ordinary textbook learning.
